name: Meat Eat Girl
original_name: ミート・イート・ガール
source:
My name is Aoki Ryota, the head of the Manga Club, which is in danger of being disbanded due to the school's sudden revision of the requirements for establishing a club.

･･･"There must be 5 or more members"

...Yes...Currently, I am the only member of the club. "If you join, I'll take responsibility and support you," I said, making compromises like that. At that point, I ran around desperately to gather members, and as a result, I was able to successfully secure four members.

And so a story of various kinds begins... set in a manga club that is on the verge of being erased.

"New Manga Club, first day of club activities

Now I feel even more uncomfortable... and strangely excited... There are four girls and one guy in this small clubroom... And they're all more defenseless than I thought?

"1. I'm trying to get an idea for a romance manga, so please help me out, manager. I'll follow up with this, so promise me you'll help, alright?♪"

This request was brought up by my lack of focus, as I was only thinking about the survival of the Manga Club...

As an older member of the club, I tried to maintain my dignity as club president so that they wouldn't notice my excitement, and my summer club activities with these free-spirited, voluptuous... I mean! free-spirited girls!

[Translated from [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HP/meat/top.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
我叫青木良太，是漫画社的社长，由于学校突然修改社团成立条件，漫画社面临解散的危险。

･･･“成员必须有5人以上”

……是的……目前，我是俱乐部唯一的成员。“如果你加入，我会承担责任并支持你，”我说，做出这样的妥协。当时我就拼命地跑来跑去召集成员，结果成功拉到了四名成员。

于是，一个各种各样的故事开始了……以一个濒临被抹去的漫画俱乐部为背景。

“新漫画社，社团活动第一天

现在我感觉更不舒服了……而且莫名的兴奋……这个小小的俱乐部里有四个女孩和一个男人……而且他们都比我想象的更毫无防备？

“1.我正在尝试创作一部浪漫漫画，请帮帮我，经理。我会跟进此事的，所以答应我你会帮忙，好吗？”

这个请求是因为我注意力不集中而提出的，因为我只想着漫画社的生存……

作为俱乐部的一名年长会员，我试图保持作为俱乐部主席的尊严，这样他们就不会注意到我的兴奋，以及我与这些自由奔放、性感的夏季俱乐部活动……我的意思是！自由奔放的女孩们！”

[翻译自[url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HP/meat/top.html]官方网站[/url]]
